scientific_integrity: Exact finite-state symbolic proof and independently replayed rational tests; general Markov resolvent identity is not claimed as new.
scientific_limitations: Constant-rate two-patch binary occupancy, initially both occupied, fixed sum of successful directional recolonization intensities; no general stochastic-dominance claim; older related texts incompletely accessible.
title: A distributional symmetry and sharp balanced-rescue optimum in two-patch extinction
